project_type: React SPA manga translator with Zustand state management
build_system: Vite with TypeScript checking via tsc --noEmit
test_framework: Vitest (but tests NOT required for this sprint)
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build
test_command: N/A - no tests required for this sprint
verification_instructions: Run npm run typecheck && npm run build to ensure no type errors and successful production build
setup_instructions: npm install in the project root
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network - npm install works. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Create branch feature/alpha-sprint5 from current HEAD, keep typecheck + build passing, commit and push, open PR against main
key_patterns: Custom hooks in features/ (useViewerShortcuts, useTranslatePipeline, useTokenTracker); UI components in components/ui/; Store in store/ using Zustand persist middleware; MangaViewer.tsx is the main viewer component (~688 lines); App.tsx is the root (~857 lines) with sidebar, navigation, and engine config; types.ts has EngineId union type and TextBubble/ProcessedImage interfaces; touch events already exist in App.tsx for long-press clean mode toggle
directory_structure: Root: App.tsx, types.ts, index.css, index.tsx. components/ has MangaViewer.tsx, BubbleOverlay.tsx, ViewerToolbar.tsx, Uploader.tsx, ComparisonSlider.tsx, LibraryManager.tsx, ui/ (Toggle, Toast, BatchProgressBar, ShortcutsOverlay). features/ has viewer/ (useViewerShortcuts, downloadCanvas), translator/ (useTranslatePipeline, useTokenTracker, planPipeline, ichigoLogout), settings/ (modal components). store/ has useTranslatorStore, useAuthStore, useSessionStore, useLibraryStore, useFontsStore, useToastStore, migrations.
